# Talon Production House

> A video and photo production house and rentable studio space in Bengaluru, India. Shoots commercial films, brand campaigns, music videos, documentaries, and portrait/product stills.

Talon is a boutique production company with a small in-house crew handling direction, cinematography, and post-production. The studio floor in J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru is available for hourly, half-day, and full-day rental with lighting and grip equipment included.

## Home

A production house and rentable studio floor in Bengaluru, built for finishing quality.

Tell us about what you're building, thinking, or working on. If it matters to you, it's worth starting here.

### Capabilities

Production: End-to-End Production, Direction, Cinematography, Stills, Audio Production, Art Direction, Logistics.

Studio Rental: Cyclorama Studio, Grip and Lighting, Equipment Rental, Styling Area.

Post and Delivery: Film Editing, Color Grading, Sound Design, Motion Graphics, Distribution.

## Motion

Commercials, music videos, documentaries, and brand films shot by Talon Production House in Bengaluru. Each project page includes the full video, credits, synopsis, and production stills.

## Stills

Portrait and product photography series. Each series includes a curated gallery of high-resolution images shot by the Talon team.

## Studio

Rent Talon's Bengaluru studio floor by the hour, half day, or full day, with camera and lighting add-ons available. Message on WhatsApp for a quote.

### Location

J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru

Address: #12, 4th Floor, 16th Cross, 20th Main, Opp. Samved School, J. P. Nagar 5th Phase, Bengaluru 560078, Karnataka, India.

### Studio Specs

Backdrops: Paper Roll (Baby pink, White, Black), Painted Wall (Double-sided, moveable).

Power: Power backup, extension cables, and power board.

Grip and Lighting: Nantu 500W LED Light with Octabox (x2), Godox AD600 Pro with Octabox, Godox AD200 Pro with Octabox (x2), Godox XPro Trigger, Heavy-duty C-Stands, Boom Arm and Arm Rods.

Amenities: Free Wi-Fi, changing room, makeup area.

### Studio Rates

Hourly: 1 hour at INR 1,499. Half day: 4 hours at INR 4,999. Full day: 9 AM to 6 PM at INR 9,999.

Equipment add-ons: Double-sided studio wall at INR 999/day, Baby Pink Paper roll at INR 499/day, Sony A7 IV camera body at INR 1,499/day, Sigma 35mm f/1.4 lens at INR 699/day, DJI RS 3 gimbal at INR 999/day.

Quotes exclude tax. Camera, lens, and gimbal rented per day, subject to availability. Reserve in advance. Damage charged as per actuals.

## The Team

### Pratham Raje Urs, CEO and Founder

Pratham is the founder and CEO of Talon Production House, a production company built on a singular vision: craft before convenience. A director and filmmaker with 6 years of experience, he oversees every project from concept through final delivery, working with the conviction that the work itself is the only portfolio that matters.

### Vikram Adithya Reddy, Managing Director

Vikram is the producer behind Talon's operational backbone, bringing 3 years of experience to every shoot. He makes sure every shoot runs on time, every rental is seamless, and every client interaction reflects the standard the studio was built on: no shortcuts, no surprises.
